task_text: Put the 2 plastic bottles into the bin. Success: all 2 bottles are inside the bin at the same time: each bottle's centre of mass within the bin's inner radius of its axis (the bin widens towards the top), not below its floor, and at most about one bottle length above its rim (a bottle may still be held). The goal must hold for 30 consecutive control steps (1.02 s); the episode then ends in success.
